package.name: s10_ros1_control
package.description: ROS 1 motion interface for the S10: /cmd_vel (geometry_msgs/Twist) and /web_cmd (std_msgs/String: stand, lie down, stop, continue) mapped onto the robot's native ROS 2 /NAV_CMD, /MOTION_STATE and /GAIT with feedback from /MOTION_INFO. Dry run unless explicitly enabled.
